_howto: Moxie website review library. Add a review by copying one entry. location: "HI" for Hawaii clients, "general" for everyone else (state codes like "AZ" also work and count as non-Hawaii). Keep text under ~260 characters; longer text is trimmed on the page. Set active to false to hide a review without deleting it. After saving, changes appear within 12 hours, or right away if you open https://purge.jsdelivr.net/gh/rlucido15/moxie-email-assets@main/website/reviews.json Hawaii reviews were tagged where Moxie's owner reply includes "mahalo". "photo" is the reviewer's Google profile picture (leave it out to show their initial).
